units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 2:6">Tosef. Ohol. II, 6</cite> <he>נכנסה עליו צ׳ ומת</he> he caught cold on it (on the trepanned skull) and died.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:3:7">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>תשעים … מתים בצ׳ וכ׳</he> ninety-nine men die from cold to one by the hands of heaven; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:4">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>כל חלי</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:15">Deut. VII, 15</cite>) <he>זו צ׳</he> that means cold.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3:5">Tosef. Sabb. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:5">IV</cite>), 5 <he>צִינָּתָן</he>; Y. ib. III, 6ᵇ top <he>צִינָּתָהּ</he>, v. <cite ref="Q00152"><he>פּוּג</he></cite> h.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>צִנִּים</he>, <he>צִנִּין</he>, <cite ref="R00030"><he>צִי׳</he></cite>. Y. B. Kam. VIII, beg. 6ᵇ <he>הטיל עליו שלג או צ׳ וכ׳</he> if he put snow or ice-cold water &c.; ib. bot. <he>צונן</he>.

Ex. R. s. 25, beg. בקש צ׳ … בקש חמים וכ׳ (not גחלים) if he wants ice-water, he gets it (out of the milliarium); if he wants hot water &c.; (Tanḥ. Vayera 10 חמין … צונן).—צ׳ פחים (adopted from Prov. XXII, 5) blowing cold winds, cold draughts; [oth. opin.: צ׳ ופ׳ cold and heat, v. פַּח II]. B. Mets. l. c.; Ab. Zar. 3ᵇ; Keth. 30ᵃ; B. Bath. 144ᵇ הכל בידי שמים חוץ מצ׳ פ׳ everything is in the power of heavens (comes from no fault of man), except sickness from cold droughts, as we read (Prov. l. c.) &c.; Yalk. Prov. 960 מצ׳ ופ׳.
